user.title: Spool Inventory
user.description: Set up a local filament spool inventory. Spools are stored in Home Assistant and nothing is sent to the cloud.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Spool Inventory is already set up.

not_loaded.message: Spool Inventory is not set up. Add it under Settings > Devices & services.

not_a_spool.message: This action only works on spool sensors, not on the summary sensors.

weight_conflict.message: Provide either remaining_weight or gross_weight, not both.

gross_below_tare.message: The weighed value ({gross} g) is lower than the empty spool weight ({tare} g). Check the empty spool weight.

catalog_full.message: Your own catalog is full (500 entries). Remove some entries first.

import_invalid.message: That file is not a Spool Inventory backup.

not_in_trash.message: That spool is no longer in the recently deleted list.

task_not_found.message: That maintenance task does not exist.

item_not_found.message: That part or consumable does not exist.

task_invalid.message: The maintenance task needs a name, an interval of 1 to 3650 days and a date that is not in the future.

item_invalid.message: The part or consumable needs a name and valid numbers.

equipment_full.message: The limit of printers, tasks or items is reached.

add_spool.name: Add spool
add_spool.description: Adds a spool to the inventory. Give either the remaining filament or the gross weight from your scale.

vendor.name: Vendor
vendor.description: Brand or manufacturer, for example Prusament.

product.name: Product line
product.description: Optional product line, for example Matte PETG. Leave empty if it is the plain material.

initial_weight.name: Net weight when new
initial_weight.description: Filament weight on a new spool in grams, without the empty spool.

spool_weight.name: Empty spool weight
spool_weight.description: Weight of the empty spool in grams. Needed to turn a scale reading into remaining filament.

gross_weight.name: Weighed gross weight
gross_weight.description: Spool plus filament on the scale in grams. Remaining filament is this minus the empty spool weight.

remaining_weight.name: Remaining filament
remaining_weight.description: Filament left in grams. Defaults to the full net weight.

price.name: Price
price.description: What you paid for the spool.

tag_id.name: NFC tag ID
tag_id.description: Optional identifier of an NFC tag, reserved for future use.

loaded.name: Loaded in printer
loaded.description: Whether this spool is currently loaded in the printer.

reorder.name: Needs reordering
reorder.description: Put the spool on the reorder list.

refill.name: Refill
refill.description: Whether this is a spool-less refill (for example a Prusament 900 g refill) used on a reusable spool.

update_spool.name: Update spool
update_spool.description: Changes details or weights of a spool.

product.name: Product line
product.description: Optional product line, for example Matte PETG. Leave empty if it is the plain material.

initial_weight.name: Net weight when new
initial_weight.description: Filament weight on a new spool in grams.

spool_weight.name: Empty spool weight
spool_weight.description: Weight of the empty spool in grams.

price.name: Price
price.description: What you paid for the spool.

loaded.name: Loaded in printer
loaded.description: Whether this spool is currently loaded in the printer.

reorder.name: Needs reordering
reorder.description: Put the spool on the reorder list.

refill.name: Refill
refill.description: Whether this is a spool-less refill (for example a Prusament 900 g refill) used on a reusable spool.

weigh_spool.name: Weigh spool
weigh_spool.description: Sets the remaining filament from a scale reading. Remaining filament equals the gross weight minus the empty spool weight.

gross_weight.name: Gross weight
gross_weight.description: Spool plus filament on the scale in grams.

spool_weight.name: Empty spool weight
spool_weight.description: Optional. Saves a new empty spool weight for this spool.

consume_filament.name: Consume filament
consume_filament.description: Subtracts used filament from a spool.

delete_spool.name: Delete spool
delete_spool.description: Removes a spool from the inventory.

list_spools.name: List spools
list_spools.description: Returns all spools with their details, optionally filtered by material or vendor.

material.name: Material
material.description: Only return spools of this material.

vendor.name: Vendor
vendor.description: Only return spools from this vendor.

location.name: Location
location.description: Only spools stored in this location.

loaded.name: Loaded in printer
loaded.description: Only spools that are (or are not) loaded in the printer.

reorder.name: Needs reordering
reorder.description: Only spools that are (or are not) on the reorder list.
